scientific_checks.distinct_responsibility_from_m6: M2 handles structural and surface readability metrics calculated deterministically via closed-form equations (Flesch-Kincaid) plus lexical diversity gating. M6 handles subjective human clinician evaluation of empathy and actionability on multi-turn dialogue.
scientific_checks.formula_vs_ml_separation: Standard reading grade level is calculated directly via mathematical equations to prevent redundant machine learning approximation of closed-form formulas.
